identified_issues: Strain gauge telemetry (+12.4 mV) falls outside nominal band (0.0 mV ± 2.0 mV) and cannot be definitively attributed to transient thermal contraction versus structural shear cracking based on scalar Channel 1 voltage alone.
Critical diagnostic verification step omitted: Channel 2 integrated ultrasonic pulse diagnostic is currently marked OFFLINE / NOT_EXECUTED.
Housing temperature sensors are still transitioning and have not reached steady-state, preventing verification of thermal equilibrium.
evidence: Transducer Bridge Channel 1 reads +12.4 mV, which aligns with both Mechanism A (transient thermal contraction offset +10 mV to +15 mV) and Mechanism B (drive shaft shear micro-crack offset +10 mV to +15 mV).
Integrated ultrasonic pulse diagnostic on Channel 2 capable of detecting structural acoustic discontinuities is OFFLINE / NOT_EXECUTED.
Temperature sensors have not verified thermal equilibrium (expected ~90 seconds post-fill initiation) to confirm dissipation of transient contraction.
recommended_action: Hold automated valve opening sequence. Maintain FV-204 in stationary closed position. Bring Channel 2 ultrasonic pulse diagnostic online and execute material acoustic scan to rule out drive shaft micro-cracks. Allow chilldown to proceed until housing temperature sensors confirm thermal steady-state equilibrium, then verify whether Channel 1 strain gauge reading returns to nominal band (0.0 mV ± 2.0 mV) prior to authorizing actuation.
